body:
So I found this product on the interwebz, from a website that contributes to scientific research.
They make a blend of base product with glycerine so that it could be used in vaping machines. Opium 2.0 in a sense. Looks badass but it's really just a narcotic which is "prepared"
.
No noticeable histamine production, no itches.
It doesn't induce 'psychotic dreams'
. The result is a fairly smooth product which makes
me calm, easy peasy relaxed like
I'm hovering over life. Warm inside too, like with an oxy. It is not the most anesthetic narcotic product.
Quite quickly absorbed I'd say in 2 minutes effects look like they peak, but they take more like 30s to 1min to start to rush. Swallowing the smoke it what I did. Dosage-wise one should be really careful because first off, one smokes progressively so not the whole dose at once. Second there is a certain amount of product lost in the process.
This is what a "pure" narcotic feels like, without any influence from histamine reactions, or mixes with other products.
In this form it is so easy to just redrop and take more. It feels like there is nothing to stop
me from accumulating mg's from
my little vape
. The product is after all, of comparable power versus heroin if not more, just without the parasite effects, since -nitazenes are more modern and synthetic.
And in my experience one feels an urge to "be nice" with everybody so I planned the trip with people whom I know don't mess around.
I doze off into sleep if taken in the evening. And as with every "novelty" that hits the market you better have appropriate naloxone on hand for a case in which you get the math wrong XD
